Structure of Book Notes

Each book note follows a consistent, high-retention template:

  1. Executive Summary — The core thesis and 3-5 minute quick briefing.
  2. Key Mental Models & Diagrams — Core architectural concepts visualised.
  3. Chapter-by-Chapter Breakdown — Deep dive into core chapters with code snippets and real-world applications.
  4. Actionable Takeaways — Best practices and checklist items to apply directly in daily engineering work.
  5. Favorite Quotes & References — Notable excerpts and citations from the author.

Adding a New Book

When you provide a book PDF, notes can be added under:

docs/books/
└── <book-slug>/
    ├── README.md           # Book overview & chapter index
    ├── chapter-01.md       # (Optional) Individual chapter breakdowns
    └── ...

Each book will automatically have its own collapsible category in the side menu!
